item.title: MK Yaakov Asher: United Torah Judaism has no desire to bring anyone down or crown anyone
item.description:
United Torah Judaism chairman MK Yaakov Asher responded to reports that the Gur Hasidic movement is considering abstaining from a vote if Gadi Eisenkot succeeds in forming the next government.
“United Torah Judaism has no desire to bring anyone down or crown anyone, and we do not act out of revenge or any other interests. The only thing guiding us is the directive of the leading rabbis, according to which United Torah Judaism, in all its components, will neither support nor join any government without securing the status of Torah scholars," Asher said.

item.title: Reports in Iran of explosion on Qeshm Island
item.description:
Iranian news agencies reported an explosion that was heard on Qeshm Island on Monday evening.
Iranian state TV later reported that the blasts were likely warning shots aimed at vessels in violation, and did not provide further details.

item.title: Prime Minister's Office rejects Associated Press report on UAE meeting as 'fake news'
item.description:
The Prime Minister’s Office rejected a report in The Associated Press alleging that Netanyahu specifically requested, during his meeting with UAE President Sheikh Mohamed bin Zayed, that the UAE President deny a report published earlier this month by Haaretz, stating the UAE President had contacted Netanyahu in late September 2023 to warn him that Hamas was preparing a major attack against Israel.
“Fake news. The visit focused solely on strengthening relations between the two countries and addressing regional challenges," the Prime Minister’s Office said.

item.title: PM's office: UAE visit focused on strengthening relations between the two countries
item.description:
Prime Minister’s Benjamin Netanyahu's Office on Monday evening issued a statement about the Prime Minister's Sunday visit to the United Arab Emirates (UAE).
"Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu and his wife visited the United Arab Emirates yesterday at the invitation of UAE President Sheikh Mohamed bin Zayed," the statement said.
"The visit focused on strengthening relations between the two countries and addressing regional challenges. The National Security Council director, Mossad chief, military secretary, and political adviser also took part in the visit."

item.title: IDF eliminares 2 suspects who enter Security Zone in Lebanon
item.description:
Earlier today (Monday), IDF soldiers operating in southern Lebanon identified two suspects who entered the Security Zone and approached the soldiers.
Following the identifiction, the soldiers opened fire toward the suspects, the suspects were neutralized. No IDF injuries were reported, the incident is under review.

item.title: Interceptor launched at suspicious aerial target in southern Lebanon

item.title: IDF foils attempted smuggling of weapons and ammunition on eastern border
item.description:
Overnight (Monday), IDF observation posts and the Israeli Air Force’s Aerial Control Unit identified a drone crossing from the east into Israeli territory in an attempt to smuggle weapons.
Following the identification, IDF soldiers were dispatched to the area and located the drone, which was carrying nine Kalashnikov rifles, magazines, and a handgun.
The weapons were transferred to the security forces for further handling.
